controls.title: Network Security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
controls.guidance: Implement boundary firewalls, network access controls, and prevent unauthorized inter-network communications.

controls.title: Segregation of Networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.
controls.guidance: Segregate network perimeters using VLANs, zones, and stateful firewalls between public and private internal data assets.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
controls.guidance: Enforce strong TLS and SSH encryption for management communications and disable plaintext access.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.
controls.guidance: Configure firewall drop logging and remote syslog aggregation.
